title: Seats and the board say agents are paused: the Seats banner with the seat's last line, the WORKING next-step names the reset time
description:
SPIDR child 3c of task-ac71a55ead3d468eab7329131f04ab7e. dependsOn child 3b task-66dc48690fd94b07905a2aa6ffb9568d (`useProviderPause()` in apps/control-room/src/v2/shell/pause-context.tsx). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 9e9b7b04. WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the Seats panel banner + the seat-exit last line, and the board header's next-step while paused. NO daemon, shell, e2e or runbook change. MEASURED (re-measure before planning): - apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/activity-screens.tsx (162): `SessionsPanel({ nowMs, outcome })` :104-160, test ids `cr.sessions.*`, the empty line "No agent seat is open right now..." :139; activity-screens.test.tsx (107) `describe("SessionsPanel")` :79. The live host is v2/ops/live-ops.tsx `LiveSessions` :117-121 (passes only nowMs + outcome). - apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/goal-status.ts (164): `deriveGoalStatus(input: { coverage, goalId, runId, surface })` :89-94; the WORKING branch :151-159 answers `next = { anchor: "board", label: "Watch the board", detail: ... }`; stage precedence is the order of the returns (:98-160). goal-status.test.tsx (99). Call sites: v2/board/board-screen.tsx:70 (`deriveGoalStatus({ coverage, goalId, runId, surface })`, 218 lines) and v2/goals/goal-status-strip.tsx:107 (`LiveGoalStatus`, 108 lines); the header renders `next.label` at v2/board/board-header.tsx:31-44 (`cr.kanban.next`). - The pause shape: 3b's `ProviderPause` = { lastLine, provider, resetAt, since, workItemId }. FEATURE: `SessionsPanel` gains `paused?: ProviderPause | null` (LiveSessions passes `useProviderPause()`) and renders, above the list and before the empty line, `

Agents paused: limit, resumes - the seat's last line:

` while paused, nothing otherwise. `deriveGoalStatus` input gains `paused?: ProviderPause | null`; when the stage is WORKING and `paused` is set, `next = { anchor: "board", label: "Waiting for the provider limit to reset at ", detail: "The seat hit its limit on ; the wrapper staffs again at ." }` - every other stage is unchanged (a READY_TO_CLOSE or ESCALATION goal ignores the pause). Both call sites pass `useProviderPause()`.
definitionOfDone: activity-screens.test.tsx arms: with `paused` the Seats panel renders cr.sessions.paused with the exact sentence including the fixture's lastLine (time formatted in the test from the same resetAt), and it renders even when no agent seat is live (the 'No agent seat is open' line stays too); without `paused` queryByTestId is null; existing SessionsPanel arms green unchanged (count line quoted).

goal-status.test.tsx arms: a WORKING goal with `paused` answers label 'Waiting for the provider limit to reset at <time>' and the detail naming the provider and workItemId; the same input without `paused` answers 'Watch the board' byte-for-byte as today; a READY_TO_CLOSE goal with `paused` keeps its own next-step (precedence unchanged).

Both call sites and the Seats host are wired: `grep -n "useProviderPause" apps/control-room/src/v2/board/board-screen.tsx apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/goal-status-strip.tsx apps/control-room/src/v2/ops/live-ops.tsx` = 3 hits, each covered by a render test that wraps the component in ProviderPauseProvider and asserts the banner / next-step text (board-screen.test / goal-status-strip.test / live-ops.test - name the files that exist).

Gates quoted with count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`; every touched production file stays <= 250 (`wc -l` quoted); sources ASCII-only, JSX text apostrophe-free (use ' - ' not an apostrophe in the sentences); every arm mutated red once.
taskRails: CONSUME THE CONTEXT: read the pause through useProviderPause(); never a second health poll on a screen.
PRECEDENCE UNCHANGED: only the WORKING branch of deriveGoalStatus reads the pause; every other stage answers exactly as today (existing goal-status arms unchanged).
NO daemon/shell/e2e/docs change; <=250 lines per production source; ASCII-only sources; JSX apostrophe-free.
